title: Software Engineer
description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
  
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.

**We’re Hiring: Software Test Engineer**

Do you know a recent engineering graduate who enjoys solving problems, questioning how systems work, and discovering what others might miss?

We are looking for curious, analytical, and technology-focused graduates to join our Software Quality Engineering team in Kolkata. This opportunity is ideal for candidates who want to build a career in software testing while gaining hands-on experience with enterprise applications, Agile development, automation, APIs, cloud technologies, and AI.

**What Will You Do?**

As part of the Software Quality Engineering team, you will:

* Analyze business needs and software requirements, and identify gaps, risks, and testability concerns early.
* Own test planning and test strategy for features and releases, including scope, approach, and risk-based prioritization.
* Design comprehensive test scenarios and test cases that cover end-to-end business workflows, integrations, and edge cases.
* Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing, analyze results, and report defects with clear root-cause insights.
* Build, maintain, and enhance automated test suites for UI and API layers.
* Perform API testing and back-end data validation.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and track quality metrics.
* Interpret workflows, architecture diagrams, business processes, and system interactions to design effective tests.
* Collaborate closely with developers, architects, business analysts, product owners, and fellow quality engineers.
* Participate actively in Scaled Agile activities, including PI Planning, sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Drive continuous improvement in test coverage, efficiency, and overall product quality.

**What Are We Looking For?**

We are looking for candidates who demonstrate:

* 3-4 years of hands-on experience in software testing and quality engineering.
* Strong analytical, logical reasoning, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to testing.
* The ability to translate complex requirements into meaningful test conditions and coverage.
* Solid experience with SDLC, STLC, defect life cycle, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Proven experience in functional, integration, and regression testing.
* Hands-on experience with test automation using tools such as Playwright, or similar.
* Programming or scripting proficiency in at least one language (Java, Python, JavaScript).
* Experience with API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to raise risks and quality concerns.
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across teams.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a drive to keep learning.

**Skills That Will Give Candidates an Advantage**

Experience in any of the following areas will be valuable:

* Designing or maintaining test automation frameworks.
* Understanding of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps pipelines
* Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure)
* Internet of Things
* Using AI tools in testing
* ISTQB or equivalent testing certification

**Who Can Apply?**

* Candidates with a B.Tech/B.E., MCA, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Candidates with 3-4 years of relevant software testing experience.
* Candidates with a strong academic record and a consistent track record of delivery.
* Candidates who can join within the expected notice period.

**Employment Details**

* Position: Software Test Engineer
* Experience: 3-4 years
* Location: Kolkata
* Employment type: Full-time
* Joining timeline: TBD

title: Purchase Developer
description:
PURCHASE DEVELOPER – STEEL INDUSTRY

**Company:** Shree Ji Steel Private Limited  
**Location:** Sector V, Salt Lake, Kolkata – On-site  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹22,000 per month  
**Experience Required:** 1–2 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Permanent  
**Qualification:** Graduate Preferred

About Shree Ji Steel

Shree Ji Steel Private Limited is a growing company in the iron and steel industry, engaged in the manufacturing, trading, and export of a wide range of steel products.

We work with steel manufacturers, mills, stockists, distributors, traders, fabricators, and suppliers across India. Our business focuses on competitive sourcing, supplier development, quality products, efficient procurement, timely delivery, and long-term business relationships.

We are looking for a **Purchase Developer – Steel Industry** who will be responsible for developing new suppliers, identifying competitive procurement sources, collecting market rates, researching steel manufacturers and stockists, and supporting the company in building a strong and reliable supplier network.

The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, strong vendor-follow-up abilities, basic knowledge of steel products, good market research skills, and a willingness to develop new supplier relationships.

Job Summary

The **Purchase Developer – Steel Industry** will focus on developing and expanding the company's supplier network for steel and related products.

The candidate will identify new manufacturers, stockists, traders, and suppliers; collect quotations and market rates; compare prices and specifications; verify material availability; negotiate where required; and maintain an updated supplier database.

The role will involve extensive **supplier research, cold calling, WhatsApp/email communication, quotation collection, rate comparison, market intelligence, and vendor development**.

Experience in the **steel industry, construction materials, manufacturing, engineering products, industrial products, or B2B procurement** will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. New Supplier & Vendor Development

* Identify and develop new suppliers, manufacturers, stockists, traders, and distributors across India.
* Search for suppliers based on product, size, grade, quantity, location, price, brand, and delivery requirements.
* Contact potential suppliers through phone calls, WhatsApp, email, B2B portals, websites, directories, and other sources.
* Introduce the company and establish professional relationships with new vendors.
* Collect supplier profiles, contact details, product ranges, and commercial information.
* Build and maintain a strong database of verified steel suppliers.
* Regularly follow up with newly identified suppliers to develop long-term business relationships.
* Identify alternative suppliers for regularly purchased and difficult-to-source materials.

2. Steel Market Research & Sourcing

* Research the Indian steel market to identify manufacturers, mills, stockists, traders, and distributors.
* Identify sources for products such as:
* TMT Bars
* MS Angles
* MS Channels
* MS Beams
* ISMB / ISMC / ISHB
* HEB / IPB / NPB
* MS Flats
* MS Plates
* Chequered Plates
* MS Round Bars
* Pipes
* GI Pipes
* Structural Steel
* Other industrial steel products
* Collect current supplier rates and market quotations.
* Track changes in steel prices, availability, brands, grades, and supply conditions.
* Identify competitive procurement opportunities from different locations and suppliers.
* Research new manufacturers and stockists based on specific product requirements.

3. Rate Collection & Quotation Development

* Contact multiple suppliers for competitive quotations.
* Collect rates based on product size, grade, quantity, brand, and delivery location.
* Compare supplier quotations and identify commercially suitable sources.
* Verify whether quoted rates include GST, freight, loading, and other applicable charges.
* Maintain supplier-wise rate records for future purchasing.
* Regularly update market rates and supplier quotations.
* Escalate significant price differences or market changes to the Purchase/Senior Management Team.

4. Supplier Verification & Evaluation

* Collect basic company information from new suppliers.
* Verify supplier product range, location, stock availability, and supply capability.
* Check manufacturer/brand details wherever applicable.
* Evaluate suppliers based on price, quality, availability, delivery capability, response time, and reliability.
* Maintain records of verified and potential suppliers.
* Identify reliable suppliers for recurring procurement requirements.

5. Purchase Development

* Study ongoing purchase requirements and identify potential suppliers.
* Develop new procurement sources for regular and non-regular materials.
* Assist the Purchase Team in obtaining better sourcing options.
* Search for alternative brands, manufacturers, stockists, or locations when required.
* Support the team in reducing sourcing time and improving supplier availability.
* Develop supplier relationships that can support bulk and repeat purchases.

6. Order & Supplier Follow-up

* Follow up with suppliers after quotation and order discussions.
* Confirm stock availability and expected dispatch timelines.
* Coordinate with suppliers regarding loading, dispatch, vehicle placement, and delivery status when required.
* Follow up on pending quotations and purchase requirements.
* Communicate supplier delays, price changes, stock shortages, or other issues to the concerned team.
* Maintain regular communication with active suppliers.
* Continuously research new steel suppliers across different regions of India.
* Identify supplier clusters and major steel markets.
* Develop databases of manufacturers, stockists, traders, and distributors.
* Track supplier contact persons, product categories, locations, and commercial terms.
* Regularly update outdated supplier information.
* Provide market information to the Purchase and Management Team.

**Required Skills**

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong cold-calling and supplier-development skills.
* Strong vendor follow-up ability.
* Good negotiation and price-comparison skills.
* Basic knowledge of steel products and specifications.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office.
* Strong internet and market-research skills.
* Ability to search and identify new suppliers through online and offline sources.
* Good data-management and documentation skills.
* Ability to compare rates, sizes, grades, quantities, and delivery terms.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to communicate with multiple suppliers on a daily basis.
* Good organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to work with targets and deadlines.
* Willingness to learn about steel markets, products, manufacturers, and B2B procurement.

Qualifications & Eligibility

* Graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Supply Chain Management, or a related field preferred.
* **1–2 years of experience in Purchase, Procurement, Vendor Development, Sourcing, Business Development, or a similar role preferred.**
* Experience in **steel, construction materials, manufacturing, engineering, industrial products, or B2B procurement** will be an added advantage.
* Candidates with experience in supplier development, market research, cold calling, quotation collection, and rate comparison will be preferred.
* Candidates with strong Excel and communication skills are encouraged to apply.

Key Performance Areas

The candidate will be evaluated based on:

* Number of new suppliers identified and developed.
* Quality and reliability of new suppliers.
* Number of competitive quotations collected.
* Supplier response and follow-up efficiency.
* Accuracy of supplier and quotation data.
* Quality of rate comparison and market research.
* Development of new sourcing channels.
* Ability to identify competitive procurement opportunities.
* Timely updating of supplier databases.
* Supplier relationship development.
* Timely support to the Purchase Team.
* Ability to source required steel materials efficiently.

What We Offer

* Salary of **₹13,000 – ₹18,000 per month**, depending on experience and skills.
* Professional training and learning opportunities.
* Career growth in **steel procurement, sourcing, and B2B trading**.
* Exposure to steel manufacturers, mills, stockists, and suppliers across India.
* Opportunity to develop strong supplier-development and negotiation skills.
* Professional and supportive working environment.
* Opportunity to build expertise in the Indian steel market.

Work Location

**Sector V, Salt Lake, Kolkata**

**Work Mode:** On-site / In-person  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Permanent

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at:

**hr@shreejisteelcorp.com**

**Subject:** Application for Purchase Developer – Steel Industry – [Candidate Name]

**Experience:** 1 year in Purchase / Procurement / Sourcing / Vendor Development preferred

**Work Location:** In person

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹22,000.00 per month

**Atlassian can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Join Atlassian as an intern and spend your summer with us having an impact on how millions of users collaborate and use software. We're in the business of developing software to help teams everywhere get amazing ideas on the ground and into the world. Sound like an exciting place to start your career? Here you'll be encouraged to use your imagination and try new things. You'll be guided (as we are) by our core values, and you'll be supported by some of the best minds in tech.

Apply for our Summer 2023 Intern Program and start an awesome career! Our paid internship program runs for 12 weeks between May/June \- August/September 2023\.

**More about our team**

You'll join a team that is smart and direct. We challenge each other to improve our work, learn, and ask hard questions. We're dedicated to Agile methodology and are big believers in 'lean' (which means we don't do documentation for documentation's sake). We know the importance of validating assumptions about users and use multiple types of testing to figure out whether we're right (or wrong). Our bottom line is improving our user's experience—no matter what.

On your first day, we'll expect you to:

* Be currently enrolled in a full\-time degree program and returning to the program after the completion of the internship, graduating by June 2024
* Have experience with Java, Python, C, C\+\+, or other related object\-oriented programming language
* Be able to commit to a full\-time (40hrs / week) internship during summer 2023

It's great, but not required, if you:

* Have experience with software engineering, expressed by previous internships, work experience, projects, or publications
* Understand data structures \- in particular how they are implemented and how to apply them
* Be familiar with the application of common design patterns

**Our perks \& benefits**

To support you at work and play, our perks and benefits include ample time off, an annual education budget, paid volunteer days, and so much more.

**About Atlassian**

The world’s best teams work better together with Atlassian. From medicine and space travel, to disaster response and pizza deliveries, Atlassian software products help teams all over the planet. At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. **Job description**

Requisition ID: 1746617

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Consulting \- Senior \- Critical Manufacturing MES Modeler/ Developer**



At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.



We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.



Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  


**About Global Delivery Services**



Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.



Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.



Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.



Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.



Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  


**The Opportunity**



We are seeking an experienced Critical Manufacturing MES Modeller to lead the design, configuration, and implementation of Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions using the Critical Manufacturing platform. The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating manufacturing business processes into scalable MES models, configuring workflows, products, resources, and equipment, and ensuring seamless integration with enterprise and shop\-floor systems.



The role requires strong expertise in MES modeling, production workflows, manufacturing operations, and system integrations. The candidate will collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, quality teams, and IT organizations to deliver robust MES solutions that drive operational excellence, traceability, compliance, and digital transformation initiatives.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead MES modeling and configuration using Critical Manufacturing MES.
* Design products, routings, workflows, DCPs, and equipment/resource models.
* Translate manufacturing processes and SOPs into scalable MES solutions.
* Define modeling standards, templates, and best practices.
* Perform fit\-gap analysis and develop solution blueprints.
* Configure MES modules including Work Execution, SPC, NC/CAPA, Traceability, EBR/eDHR, Equipment Integration, and Scheduling.
* Lead MES integrations with ERP systems and shop\-floor systems.
* Ensure data integrity, version control, and lifecycle management.
* Mentor team members and lead design/configuration reviews.
* Support validation, testing, deployment, and hypercare activities.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* 4\+ years of handson experience in Critical Manufacturing MES implementations and Rollouts, master data modelling and enrichment.
* Certified Critical Manufacturing Professional / Associate: Modeler/Developer
* Previous work experience in MES implementation using any platform.
* Strong knowledge of production modeling, workflow configuration, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).
* Experience in MES\-ERP integrations and manufacturing system connectivity.
* Working knowledge of SQL, REST APIs, and Critical Manufacturing MES Event Handlers.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, MES design, and configuration best practices.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and business stakeholders.
* Experience in MES implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and support activities.
* Good communication skills
* Able to work independently and have leadership skills.
* Customer\-oriented and committed to working systematically under tight schedules.
* Develop and produce technical reports, process flow diagrams and documentation in support of design and developments.
